scene.label: Act 3, Scene 2
scene.title: SCENE II. Another Part of the forest

lines.text: He has mistook the brake I meant, is gone
lines.plainText: He has mistook the brake I meant is gone

lines.text: After his fancy. 'Tis now well-nigh morning.
lines.plainText: After his fancy 'Tis now wellnigh morning

lines.text: No matter; would it were perpetual night,
lines.plainText: No matter would it were perpetual night

lines.text: And darkness lord o' th' world. Hark, 'tis a wolf!
lines.plainText: And darkness lord o' th' world Hark 'tis a wolf

lines.text: In me hath grief slain fear, and but for one thing,
lines.plainText: In me hath grief slain fear and but for one thing

lines.text: I care for nothing, and that's Palamon.
lines.plainText: I care for nothing and that's Palamon

lines.text: I reck not if the wolves would jaw me, so
lines.plainText: I reck not if the wolves would jaw me so

lines.text: He had this file. What if I hallowed for him?
lines.plainText: He had this file What if I hallowed for him

lines.text: I cannot hallow. If I whooped, what then?
lines.plainText: I cannot hallow If I whooped what then

lines.text: If he not answered, I should call a wolf,
lines.plainText: If he not answered I should call a wolf

lines.text: And do him but that service. I have heard
lines.plainText: And do him but that service I have heard

lines.text: Strange howls this livelong night; why may 't not be
lines.plainText: Strange howls this livelong night why may 't not be

lines.text: They have made prey of him? He has no weapons;
lines.plainText: They have made prey of him He has no weapons

lines.text: He cannot run; the jingling of his gyves
lines.plainText: He cannot run the jingling of his gyves

lines.text: Might call fell things to listen, who have in them
lines.plainText: Might call fell things to listen who have in them

lines.text: A sense to know a man unarmed and can
lines.plainText: A sense to know a man unarmed and can

lines.text: Smell where resistance is. I'll set it down
lines.plainText: Smell where resistance is I'll set it down

lines.text: He's torn to pieces; they howled many together,
lines.plainText: He's torn to pieces they howled many together

lines.text: And then they fed on him. So much for that.
lines.plainText: And then they fed on him So much for that

lines.text: Be bold to ring the bell. How stand I then?
lines.plainText: Be bold to ring the bell How stand I then

lines.text: All's chared when he is gone. No, no, I lie.
lines.plainText: All's chared when he is gone No no I lie

lines.text: My father's to be hanged for his escape;
lines.plainText: My father's to be hanged for his escape

lines.text: Myself to beg, if I prized life so much
lines.plainText: Myself to beg if I prized life so much

lines.text: As to deny my act; but that I would not,
lines.plainText: As to deny my act but that I would not

lines.text: Should I try death by dozens. I am moped.
lines.plainText: Should I try death by dozens I am moped

lines.text: Food took I none these two days;
lines.plainText: Food took I none these two days

lines.text: Sipped some water. I have not closed mine eyes
lines.plainText: Sipped some water I have not closed mine eyes

lines.text: Save when my lids scoured off their brine. Alas,
lines.plainText: Save when my lids scoured off their brine Alas

lines.text: Dissolve, my life! Let not my sense unsettle,
lines.plainText: Dissolve my life Let not my sense unsettle

lines.text: Lest I should drown, or stab, or hang myself.
lines.plainText: Lest I should drown or stab or hang myself

lines.text: O state of nature, fail together in me,
lines.plainText: O state of nature fail together in me

lines.text: Since thy best props are warped! So, which way now?
lines.plainText: Since thy best props are warped So which way now

lines.text: The best way is the next way to a grave;
lines.plainText: The best way is the next way to a grave

lines.text: Each errant step beside is torment. Lo,
lines.plainText: Each errant step beside is torment Lo

lines.text: The moon is down, the crickets chirp, the screech owl
lines.plainText: The moon is down the crickets chirp the screech owl

lines.text: Calls in the dawn. All offices are done
lines.plainText: Calls in the dawn All offices are done

lines.text: Save what I fail in. But the point is this:
lines.plainText: Save what I fail in But the point is this

lines.text: An end, and that is all.
lines.plainText: An end and that is all
